scenarios.name: tools/call missing required param
scenarios.note: No test sends tools/call with a required param absent and asserts the structured error response.

scenarios.name: malformed JSON-RPC (e.g. missing method/jsonrpc field)
scenarios.note: Malformed JSON covered; missing-method-field mentioned in smoke module docstring but NO corresponding test function exists.

scenarios.name: missing method field specifically (request has jsonrpc/id but no method key)
scenarios.note: Listed in smoke test module docstring but never implemented as a test function.

scenarios.name: tool internal error → structured isError:true or error object
scenarios.note: Tests only assert isError:false on success paths. No test injects a runtime exception inside a handler and verifies isError:true returned (not a protocol-level error).

scenarios.name: AgentCard missing required field rejected
scenarios.note: AgentCard.name is the only required field but no test calls AgentCard() without name and asserts ValidationError.

scenarios.name: A2AMessage invalid role/status rejected
scenarios.note: A2AMessage.role is str (no enum constraint), so this cannot raise ValidationError. A2ATaskStatus invalid value is never tested via model_validate. No pytest.raises on bad role/status.

scenarios.name: http transport SSRF rejection (file://, ftp://, localhost, private IP, metadata IP)
scenarios.test_file: tests/unit/test_a2a_http_ssrf_hardening.py::test_reject_file_scheme, test_reject_ftp_scheme, test_reject_loopback_ipv4_literal, test_reject_aws_metadata_ip, test_reject_localhost_hostname, test_reject_unspecified_ipv4, test_reject_rfc1918_class_a, test_reject_rfc1918_class_c, test_reject_loopback_ipv6_literal

scenarios.name: http timeout (max poll attempts exhausted, server stays WORKING)
scenarios.note: test_send_task_unreachable_returns_failed covers connection-refused; no test keeps a server alive returning WORKING indefinitely until max_poll_attempts is exhausted and asserts FAILED.

scenarios.name: roundtable party-mode independence (deep copy verified)
scenarios.note: Tests verify same context_id and same history length are sent to each participant, but no test explicitly mutates one participant task and asserts the others are unaffected (deep copy check).

scenarios.name: pydantic model construction with valid data
missing required field rejected
scenarios.note: No test across the entire suite calls any Pydantic model with a missing required field and asserts ValidationError. The A2A schema tests only exercise positive construction paths.

scenarios.name: invalid enum value rejected
scenarios.note: A2ATaskStatus is tested for valid values only. No test passes an invalid string to model_validate and asserts ValidationError.

scenarios.name: nested model invalid rejected
scenarios.note: A2APart/A2AMessage nesting is only exercised with valid data. No test injects bad data into a nested field.

scenarios.name: backward-compat for v0.1.0a1 schemas exported
scenarios.note: The schemas.py file has no __all__ or version-guard; no test imports from a frozen v0.1.0a1 snapshot and asserts backward-compat field presence or model_validate success.

verdict: MCP protocol coverage is adequate for the happy-path and security gates (apply guardrail thoroughly tested) but missing three protocol-level error paths: missing-method-field, missing-required-param, and tool-internal-error→isError:true. A2A coverage is strong on transport security (SSRF+DNS rebinding) but weak on schema validation (no rejection tests) and missing a poll-timeout scenario. Pydantic schema coverage is the weakest surface: only positive construction and one roundtrip are tested; all rejection paths (missing required field, invalid enum, nested invalid, backward compat) are uncovered.
